records.name: link.tracker.click.view.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <search string="Clicks">
                    <field name="link_id"/>
                    <field name="country_id"/>
                    <group>
                        <filter string="Link" name="groupby_link_id" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'link_id'}"/>
                        <filter string="Country" name="groupby_country_id" context="{'group_by': 'country_id'}"/>
                    </group>
                </search>
            </field>

records.name: link.tracker.click.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form string="Link Click">
                    <sheet>
                        <group>
                            <field name="link_id"/>
                            <field name="ip"/>
                            <field name="country_id" options="{'no_open': True, 'no_create': True}"/>
                        </group>
                    </sheet>
                </form>
            </field>

records.name: link.tracker.click.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <list string="Links Clicks">
                    <field name="link_id"/>
                    <field name="ip"/>
                    <field name="country_id"/>
                </list>
            </field>

records.name: link.tracker.click.view.graph
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <graph string="Link Clicks" type="pie" sample="1">
                    <field name="link_id"/>
                    <field name="ip"/>
                    <field name="country_id"/>
                </graph>
            </field>

records.name: link.tracker.click.view.search.inherit.mass_mailing
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='country_id']" position="after">
                <field name="campaign_id"/>
                <field name="mass_mailing_id"/>
            </xpath>
            <xpath expr="//filter[@name='groupby_country_id']" position="after">
                <filter string="Mass Mailing" name="groupby_mass_mailing_id" context="{'group_by': 'mass_mailing_id'}"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: link.tracker.click.view.form.inherit.mass_mailing
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='country_id']" position="after">
                <field name="campaign_id"/>
                <field name="mass_mailing_id"/>
                <field name="mailing_trace_id"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: link.tracker.click.view.list.inherit.mass_mailing
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='link_id']" position="after">
                <field name="campaign_id"/>
                <field name="mass_mailing_id"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: link.tracker.click.view.graph.inherit.mass_mailing
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='country_id']" position="after">
                <field name="campaign_id"/>
                <field name="mass_mailing_id"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>
